meta.title: Sleep Control
meta.description: Control system sleep from DSH settings: session-time prevention on macOS and Windows, with persistent sleep disable on macOS only.

sleepControl.title: Sleep Control
sleepControl.intro: Manage system sleep on macOS and Windows. The two methods below are independent; "Disable sleep completely" is available only on macOS.
sleepControl.caffeinateHelp: Uses caffeinate -s only while a session is running. It works with the lid open; with the lid closed, it works only while connected to power, not on battery.
sleepControl.windowsSessionHelp: Uses a Windows execution-state request (SetThreadExecutionState) to block idle system sleep while sessions run; the request ends with the helper process. The display may still turn off, and explicit actions such as closing the lid or choosing Sleep are not blocked.
sleepControl.caffeinateEnabled: Enabled: system sleep is prevented automatically whenever a session is running.
sleepControl.caffeinateDisabled: When enabled, system sleep is prevented automatically while sessions run.
sleepControl.label: Disable sleep completely
sleepControl.description: Disable macOS system sleep with pmset; administrator authorization is required
sleepControl.fullSleepHelp: This is the strongest method, but pmset changes a global, persistent power setting. It remains active after DSH exits; forgetting to restore it may cause abnormal battery drain.
sleepControl.persistentUnsupported: "Disable sleep completely" is available only on macOS and is not supported on this platform.
sleepControl.persistentUnsupportedHelp: This method relies on the macOS pmset utility; Windows has no equivalent persistent sleep disable.
sleepControl.cancelled: Authorization cancelled. The system setting was not changed.
sleepControl.unsupported: This feature is not supported on the current platform.
sleepControl.statusUnavailable: Unable to read SleepDisabled. Try again.
sleepControl.busy: Another change is already waiting for authorization.
sleepControl.commandFailed: The privileged command failed. Try again.
sleepControl.verificationFailed: The resulting system setting could not be verified. Try again.
sleepControl.networkFailed: Unable to reach the local DSH service.
sleepControl.saveFailed: The setting was not saved. Try again.
